name: Kathleen Walker

bio.statement: Walker's pamphlet statement lists her prior governmental experience as Sandy Mayor since 2025, Sandy City Council 2021-2024, and service on the Parks Board and Budget Committee.
bio.excerpt: Sandy Mayor: 2025-present; Sandy City Council: 2021-2024; Sandy Parks Board and Budget Committee

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 50 (printed C-49)

bio.statement: Walker's pamphlet statement lists her background as Mt. Hood National Forest recreation manager and forest planner, with a forestry degree.
bio.excerpt: Mt. Hood National Forest: Recreation Manager 1992 2015; Forest Planner 1983-1992;

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 50 (printed C-49)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Walker says developers must pay their share of system development charges when building.
positions.excerpt: Developers must pay their share of system development charges (SDCs) when building!

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 50 (printed C-49)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Walker says she will work to find more grant funding in Salem and Washington D.C. to lower water and sewer costs.
positions.excerpt: I will work tirelessly to find more grant funding in Salem and D.C.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 50 (printed C-49)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Walker says she will seek additional funding, without raising the safety fee, to expand the police force.
positions.excerpt: I’ll seek additional funding that doesn’t raise our safety fee, to expand our future police force.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 50 (printed C-49)
